curious.en: You've been listening to English Learning for Curious Minds by Leonardo English.
curious.zh: 你收听的是由 Leonardo English 制作的《English Learning for Curious Minds》。

curious.en: Let me know in the comments below, if you're listening to this somewhere where you can comment, and for the members among you, you can head right into our community forum, which is at community.leonardoenglish.com and get chatting away to other curious minds.
curious.zh: 如果你收听节目的地方可以评论，欢迎在下方留言；对于会员朋友，你们可以直接前往我们的社区论坛 community.leonardoenglish.com，与其他求知欲强烈的听友交流畅聊。

customer.en: There are long waiting lists to ensure that a new customer won't overload the local network, and in some parts of the United States, these waiting lists stretch to eight years, which is eight years too long if you're a technology company racing to build the next generation of AI.
customer.zh: 排队等待的名单很长，以确保新客户不会使当地网络过载，而在美国某些地区，排队时间长达八年，对于一家竞相开发下一代人工智能的科技公司来说，八年实在太漫长了。

culture.en: Some wartime dishes are still around today and they’re examples of British food culture.
culture.zh: 一些战时菜肴至今仍然存在，它们是英国饮食文化的例子。

culture.en: He returned from France with an appreciation for French food and French culture.
culture.zh: 他从法国归来，对法国食物和法国文化有了欣赏。
